newsitem.title: USA: ICF Kaiser believes it can meet 96 estimates.
newsitem.headline: ICF Kaiser believes it can meet 96 estimates.

text.p: ICF Kaiser International Inc said on Tuesday it believed it was possible to meet its full-year performance targets and analysts' 1996 earnings estimates, due to new contracts expected to close in the fourth quarter.
"Although we were somewhat disappointed by the results this quarter, the company continues to be awarded a number of major new contracts," said James Edwards, chairman and chief executive officer.
In the third quarter, earnings declined to $0.01 per share from $0.05 per share in the same period last year.
The First Call mean earnings estimate for fiscal 1996 was $0.24 per share, and $0.09 per share for the fourth quarter.
